fact: The Central Bank of Kenya (Digital Credit Providers) Regulations, Legal Notice 46 of 2022, commenced on publication in the Gazette in 2022 and were repealed on 29 September 2026 by the Central Bank of Kenya (Non-Deposit Taking Credit Providers) Regulations, 2026.
title: The Central Bank of Kenya (Digital Credit Providers) Regulations, Legal Notice 46 of 2022
